paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across values.

The plot illustrates the Macro-F1 score for two methods across a series of values. The x-axis is labeled “λ value,” features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3, and has tick labels at each 0.1 interval. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)" and displays a linear scale ranging from 72.0% to 75.0%, with tick labels at 0.5% intervals. A solid purple line, labeled “MatDetector (ours),” begins at 72.2% at λ = 0 and increases to 73.0% at λ = 0.1, and decreases to 72.7% at λ = 0.2. The line rises to 73.6% at λ = 0.3, dips to 72.9% at λ = 0.4, rises to 74.1% at λ = 0.5, and fluctuates, reaching a peak of 74.5% at λ = 0.6 and remains steady at 74.2% at λ = 0.7, before decreasing to 73.5% at λ = 0.8 and 72.8% at λ = 2.0, eventually ending at 72.2% at λ = 3.0. A dashed blue line, labeled “ChemDataExtractor,” begins at 72.4% at λ = 0, decreases to 72.3% at λ = 0.1, subsequently increases to 73.0% at λ = 0.2, and increases to 73.4% at λ = 0.3, then declines to 72.8% at λ = 0.4, before increasing to 73.6% at λ = 0.5, to 73.7% at λ = 0.6, decreases to 73.3% at λ = 0.7, and then declines to 72.7% at λ = 0.8, and 72.5% at λ = 2.0, ultimately ending at 72.2% at λ = 3.0.
